BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
